limitations: Three reused synthetic contexts, two repetitions per arm; not a production quality or population error-rate estimate.
Combined branch changes effort, prompt and schema; cannot identify an individual package's causal effect.
Source-based frozen controls are assistant judgments under the user-approved rubric, not independently human-adjudicated labels.
Reference coverage conditions on retained valid outputs; completeness failures are reported separately.
Growth Nina direct boundary and unscored proposal usefulness remain pending.
Usage is provider-reported; missing values stay missing. Sums are not independently verified cost or internal reasoning.
Original ask premises and contribution factual support require separate manual review; neutral membership is not semantic verification.
